description: The grown tree-house INTERIORS of Black Marsh & Valenwood's Bosmer city kit, packaged as the linked inside for the root/tree shells the same mod places (`housegland001`, `housechamp001`, `housetronc001` and the kiosk galleries around them). Built 2026-09-07 from the door-link manifest, not from a filename guess: `Valenwood.esp`'s own load doors teleport from those shells into cell `01treeint`, and these are exactly the interior modules used inside that cell: the `*int*` wall, chamber and trunk-connector pieces of `Architecture/CiteBosmer/Houses`, along with the Telvanni interior connector and gourd-chamber the same cell uses to join them. Every piece here was authored to combine with the others in this kit; the mod's own placement of these pieces inside one cell is the evidence. Dressing is the handful of loose props that cell repeats: benches, a bar table, hanging lamps and a brazier, and nothing else.

snapLogic.chambers: `housechampint001` is the chamber shell and `housechampintwalla15v001`/`v002` are its wall arcs. The cell repeats them 35 and 16 times around the chamber, so they tile a curved wall at a 15-degree pitch rather than on a square grid. `houseglandint001` is the pod interior that goes inside `housegland001`, `housetroncintet001`/`housetroncintet90v001`/`housetroncintrcet90v001` are the trunk sections, straight and turned 90 degrees.
snapLogic.connectors: `tel_int_connector_01` is the joint the cell uses most (46 placements): it links one chamber or trunk section to the next. `tel_int_gourdhouse01` is the small hanging chamber off a connector.
snapLogic.dressing: Loose props on the chamber floor, not snapped.
snapLogic.unitScale: Bethesda units; 0.0142240 m/unit. Measured extents per piece in tooling/asset-pipeline/output/kits/bmv-treehouse-int.kit.json.
